ns2:course.label: Seminar Ethical Theory
ns2:course.description: Intensive study of problems in ethical theory. Approved for letter grading when offered for 4 hours; approved for S/U grading when offered for 2 hours - only available for Stage 3 Philosophy PhD students. May be repeated in the same or separate terms. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
